ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a soil food web diagram titled “The Soil Food Web”. The diagram labels organisms or materials such as Plants, Organic Matter, Fungi, Bacteria, Nematodes, Arthropods, Protozoa, Animals, and Birds. In the upper right there are blue “Birds”, next to “Arthropods Predators”, and red food/energy arrows show that birds have feeding relationships with other animal-type organisms. Reasoning: The definition of a carnivore is an animal that eats other animals. In the diagram, Birds are located in a food-chain position related to animal prey, indicating that they eat other animals, so they can be considered a carnivore.
